The Door 6 gatehouse tablet freeze at Tansleigh Packaging is ticket #88412. I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread with that number.

It comes from #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. On Jul 2, 2025 Tobias reported the tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He first called the account "TP," then confirmed the ticket was for Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

I also told Hollis that PD-88412 in the Jul 13, 2026 Central weekly is a different ticket: a Marrow Fieldworks problem with trucks not auto-assigning to bays at Salina. That's so the two don't get mixed up in the tracker.
